items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I used to play with a great drummer, Jimmy Loveless. You know he’s a New York guy, he played with Wes Montgomery and was on some of his records.

ctx.x: It’s really good, because fast tempos, man, it’s all about being in sync. Like I know we talked about “Countdown” before, but let’s just say you want to learn how to play it fast. I used to play with a great drummer, Jimmy Loveless. You know he’s a New York guy, he played with Wes Montgomery and was on some of his records. But he was a real New York cat. And he used to play really fast. And I realized with him that you didn’t have to play every change. You just had to be in the vicinity of that sound. Every once…
Here’s a question that sometimes is hard to answer, but do you have a best gig and a worst gig that stick in your mind?
